edits.text:
-- skip title; first map already running
	goto_level(1)

-- gpio: berries, map, time, hook; 0x5f30 blocks the pico-8 pause menu
	poke(0x5f30,1)
	poke(0x5fe4,berry_count)
	poke(0x5fe5,level_index)
	poke2(0x5fe6,seconds+minutes*60)
	poke(0x5fe8,have_grapple and 1 or 0)
	gw_obs()

-- gw: policy observation publisher for 89_celeste-classic-2. Called once per _draw();
-- decoded by window.__gameworldObservation in game_api.js. Pins 0x5f89 onward =
-- pins 9.. ; pins 0/1 are the shell bank protocol and 100..104 the cart's own
-- berries/level/time/hook row, so neither is touched. Raw scalars only: the adapter
-- derives booleans, and reads ground/wall contact and all static geometry from the
-- level grid in RAM instead of spending cartridge tokens on it.
--   0x5f89 magic 89
--   0x5f8a x*8, 0x5f8c y*8, 0x5f8e speed_x*16, 0x5f90 speed_y*16,
--   0x5f92 grapple_x*8, 0x5f94 grapple_y*8   (int16, little-endian)
--   0x5f96 player.state      0x5f97 t_jump_grace (4 while grounded)
--   0x5f98 t_var_jump        0x5f9a frame counter
--   0x5f99 flags: 1 jump held, 2 has the grapple, 4 at a checkpoint,
--          8 carrying a berry, 16 facing right, 32 holding an object
--   0x5f9c int16 ids of the berries still in the map (draw time), terminated by
--          a zero pair; at most 6
function gw_obs()
	local p,c
	for o in all(objects) do
		if o.base==player then p=o end
		if o.base==berry and o.player and not o.collected then c=1 end
	end
	if not p then return end
	poke(0x5f89,89)
	poke2(0x5f8a,flr(p.x*8))
	poke2(0x5f8c,flr(p.y*8))
	poke2(0x5f8e,flr(p.speed_x*16))
	poke2(0x5f90,flr(p.speed_y*16))
	poke2(0x5f92,flr(p.grapple_x*8))
	poke2(0x5f94,flr(p.grapple_y*8))
	poke(0x5f96,flr(p.state))
	poke(0x5f97,p.t_jump_grace)
	poke(0x5f98,p.t_var_jump)
	poke(0x5f99,(input_jump and 1 or 0)+(have_grapple and 2 or 0)+(level_checkpoint and 4 or 0)+(c and 8 or 0)+(p.facing>0 and 16 or 0)+(p.holding and 32 or 0))
	gw_n=(gw_n or 0)+1
	poke(0x5f9a,gw_n%256)
	local b=0
	for o in all(objects) do
		if b<6 and o.base==berry and not o.player and not o.collected then
			poke2(0x5f9c+b*2,o.id)
			b+=1
		end
	end
	poke2(0x5f9c+b*2,0)
end
